title: The Invitation with No Reply
title_ja: 返事のない招待状と友達の事情
fact_notes: 登場人物と学校活動は架空の教材用の設定。英文・和訳・設問は独自制作。

sentences.en: A group of friends plans a reunion during their winter holiday after several classmates move to different towns.
sentences.ja: 友人のグループは何人かの同級生が別の町へ移った後、冬休みに再会を計画します。

sentences.en: Saki sends invitations and asks everyone to answer by Friday.
sentences.ja: サキは招待状を送り金曜日までに全員へ返事を求めます。

sentences.en: However, her close friend Ren does not reply even when the deadline passes.
sentences.ja: しかし親友のレンは締切が過ぎても返事をしません。

sentences.en: Saki worries that Ren no longer wants to spend time with their old group.
sentences.ja: サキはレンが昔の仲間ともう過ごしたくないのかと心配します。

sentences.en: Their teacher suggests that a missing reply can have several explanations.
sentences.ja: 教師は返事がないことには複数の説明があり得ると提案します。

sentences.en: Saki decides to contact Ren privately instead of criticizing him in the group chat.
sentences.ja: サキはグループチャットで責めずにレンへ個別に連絡すると決めます。

sentences.en: For example, she asks whether the date or place would make attending difficult.
sentences.ja: 例えば日時や場所が参加を難しくするか尋ねます。

sentences.en: Ren explains that he is helping his family on weekends and cannot travel easily.
sentences.ja: レンは週末に家族を手伝っていて簡単には移動できないと説明します。

sentences.en: He wanted to see his friends but felt uncomfortable asking everyone to change their plans.
sentences.ja: 友人に会いたかったものの全員に予定の変更を頼むのは気が引けたのです。

sentences.en: Saki realizes that silence was not necessarily a rejection of their friendship.
sentences.ja: サキは沈黙が必ずしも友情の拒絶を意味しないと気づきます。

sentences.en: The friends discuss several alternatives, including meeting online for part of the afternoon.
sentences.ja: 友達は午後の一部をオンラインで集まるなどいくつかの代替案を話し合います。

sentences.en: They consider a shorter event and a location closer to public transportation.
sentences.ja: 短い集まりや公共交通に近い場所も検討します。

sentences.en: Instead of demanding that Ren explain every family responsibility, they ask which options might work.
sentences.ja: レンに家庭の責任をすべて説明させるのでなく、どの案なら可能か尋ねます。

sentences.en: The group agrees that people should be able to decline an invitation without feeling ashamed.
sentences.ja: 招待を断っても恥ずかしく思う必要はないとグループは合意します。

sentences.en: They also decide to set a realistic deadline for making reservations.
sentences.ja: 予約を決めるための現実的な締切も設けます。

sentences.en: The friends choose a small in-person meeting and a short online call for those who cannot come.
sentences.ja: 友達は小さな対面の集まりと来られない人のための短いオンライン通話を選びます。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, they understand that no single plan can satisfy every person's schedule.
sentences.ja: それでも一つの計画ですべての人の予定を満たすことはできないと理解します。

sentences.en: Ren joins the online call and shares stories about his new school.
sentences.ja: レンはオンライン通話に参加し新しい学校の話を共有します。

sentences.en: Saki listens and apologizes for assuming that his delay meant he was uninterested.
sentences.ja: サキは耳を傾け返事の遅れを無関心と決めつけたことを謝ります。

sentences.en: Their conversation feels easier once they stop guessing what the other person thinks.
sentences.ja: 相手の考えを推測するのをやめると会話はずっと気楽になります。

sentences.en: After the reunion, the group writes a simple plan for future invitations.
sentences.ja: 再会後グループは今後の招待に向け簡単な計画を書きます。

sentences.en: They include clear dates, several ways to respond, and room for people to explain only what they wish to share.
sentences.ja: 明確な日付、複数の返事方法、話したいことだけを説明できる余地を含めます。

sentences.en: As a result, the friends feel more comfortable making plans without pressuring one another.
sentences.ja: その結果友達は互いに圧力をかけずにより安心して予定を立てられます。

sentences.en: Saki learns that maintaining a friendship involves respecting different circumstances and communication habits.
sentences.ja: サキは友情を続けるには異なる事情や連絡習慣を尊重することが含まれると学びます。

sentences.en: A thoughtful invitation offers a genuine choice rather than demanding proof of loyalty.
sentences.ja: 思いやりある招待は忠誠の証明を求めず本当の選択肢を与えます。

options: Ren does not reply by the deadline.
questions.explanation_ja: 第1段落「サキはレンが昔の仲間ともう過ごしたくないのかと心配します。」が正答の根拠です。

questions.prompt: What possibility does the teacher raise?
options: Ren must have rejected the friendship.
Every invitation requires a phone call.
A missing reply may have different causes.
questions.explanation_ja: 第1段落「教師は返事がないことには複数の説明があり得ると提案します。」が正答の根拠です。

questions.prompt: Why can Ren not easily attend?
options: He is preparing a school concert that night.
He has family responsibilities and travel difficulties.
He has forgotten his friends' names.
questions.explanation_ja: 第2段落「レンは週末に家族を手伝っていて簡単には移動できないと説明します。」が正答の根拠です。

questions.prompt: What does Saki come to understand?
options: Silence does not necessarily mean rejection.
questions.explanation_ja: 第2段落「サキは沈黙が必ずしも友情の拒絶を意味しないと気づきます。」が正答の根拠です。

questions.prompt: What do the friends avoid demanding?
options: Full details of Ren's family responsibilities.
questions.explanation_ja: 第3段落「レンに家庭の責任をすべて説明させるのでなく、どの案なら可能か尋ねます。」が正答の根拠です。

questions.prompt: What principle do the friends agree on?
options: Only one schedule can be proposed.
questions.explanation_ja: 第3段落「招待を断っても恥ずかしく思う必要はないとグループは合意します。」が正答の根拠です。

questions.prompt: What alternative allows Ren to participate?
options: An event held only on weekends.
A requirement to attend in person.
questions.explanation_ja: 第4段落「それでも一つの計画ですべての人の予定を満たすことはできないと理解します。」が正答の根拠です。

options: She asked the teacher for advice.
She assumed the late reply indicated a lack of interest.
She forgot the date of the holiday.
questions.explanation_ja: 第4段落「サキは耳を傾け返事の遅れを無関心と決めつけたことを謝ります。」が正答の根拠です。

questions.prompt: What do the friends include in future invitations?
options: Clear dates and different reply options.
A list ranking friends by loyalty.
questions.explanation_ja: 第5段落「明確な日付、複数の返事方法、話したいことだけを説明できる余地を含めます。」が正答の根拠です。

options: Delayed replies always reveal true feelings.
A good reunion requires everyone to attend physically.
People must explain every personal reason for declining.
Friendship planning should respect different situations and free choices.
questions.explanation_ja: 第5段落「思いやりある招待は忠誠の証明を求めず本当の選択肢を与えます。」が正答の根拠です。
